prompt: I only want to make 6 pancakes. Read this recipe and halve its quantities. Give me a short ingredient checklist and cooking steps, with the cooking time. Use only the recipe on this page. Answer in English in under 130 words.
answers:
I’ll read the recipe and halve the ingredients for 6 pancakes.
Copy

For 6 pancakes (half the recipe):

 50g plain flour
 1 large egg
 150ml milk
 ½ tbsp sunflower or vegetable oil, plus extra for frying
 ½ pinch of salt
 Optional: lemon wedges and caster sugar


Whisk flour, egg, milk, oil and salt until smooth, with the consistency of single cream.
Rest for 30 minutes if time allows, or cook immediately.
Heat a medium frying or crêpe pan over medium heat; wipe with oiled kitchen paper.
Use about half a ladleful per pancake. Cook 1 minute per side until golden; keep warm in a low oven.
Serve with optional toppings.

Cooking time: approximately 12 minutes for six, cooked individually.
